display.purpose: Shop name and page heroes, Big Shoulders Display 900 uppercase.

label.purpose: Azeret Mono stamped metadata: form labels, woven labels, size cells, barcode captions.

shadows.name: tag-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft lift under every die-cut tag; applied as a filter on the .tag-wrap wrapper because clip-path would clip box-shadow.

motion.name: tape
motion.purpose: Scrolling label tape; stopped under reduced motion.

motion.name: swing
motion.purpose: Gentle tag sway around a pivot above the tag; stopped under reduced motion.

components.name: Sticker Button
components.description: Primary action: a tilted acid price-gun sticker.
components.css: .ds-btn-sticker { background: var(--sticker, #d7ff3a); color: var(--on-sticker, #0b0b0b); font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; transform: rotate(-2deg); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-sticker:hover { transform: rotate(-2deg) translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-sticker:active { transform: rotate(-2deg) translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-sticker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { background: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); color: var(--paper, #f7f4ec); font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: rgb(11 11 11 / 0.85); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Outline button on paper; fills with ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 20px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); color: var(--paper, #f7f4ec); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Mono uppercase label over a 2px ink bordered field.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6); color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #5b564c); opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:focus { background: #fff; outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hang Tag
components.description: Die-cut paper swing tag, the surface for every card and panel.
components.html:
Wide Leg Jeans

$68
components.css: .ds-tag-wrap { filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22)); display: inline-block; } .ds-tag { background: var(--paper, #f7f4ec); color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); padding: 24px 32px; clip-path: polygon(18px 0, calc(100% - 18px) 0, 100% 18px, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 18px); } .ds-tag-title { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-tag-price { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.5rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0; }

components.name: Woven Label
components.description: Black woven label for categories and status.
components.css: .ds-woven { display: inline-block; background-color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); color: var(--paper, #f7f4ec); font-family: 'Azeret Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 2px, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 2px 3px); }

components.name: Size Run
components.description: Stamped size cells; selected is ink filled, sold-out is a dashed ghost cell.
components.css: .ds-run { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-cell { height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font-family: 'Azeret Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-cell:hover { background: rgb(11 11 11 / 0.1); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0b0b0b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-cell-on { background: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); color: var(--paper, #f7f4ec); } .ds-cell-out { border-style: dashed; border-color: rgb(11 11 11 / 0.3); color: rgb(11 11 11 / 0.35); text-decoration: line-through; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview:
The shop is a garment tag. The whole page is a drenched field of one loud colour, and everything you read or press sits on it as a physical retail object: a die-cut paper swing tag with a punched hole and string, a price-gun sticker, a black woven label, a stamped size cell, a barcode, a dashed stitch rule. Cards, panels, forms and empty states are all tags; photographs are not the container for the interface.

Density is quick and phone-first: heavy condensed uppercase display type for names and prices, a plain grotesk for reading, a mono face for small stamped labels. There are no gradients and no offset block shadows. The only depth is the soft drop shadow that lifts a tag off the field, and a small tilt on stickers.

The field colour is the one runtime variable. The user can switch palettes in Settings and the entire shop recolours; paper, ink and the tag material never change.
keyCharacteristics: One drenched field colour behind every page, with off-white paper tags and ink-black print on top.
One accent ink, the acid-yellow price-gun sticker, reserved for the primary action and price flags.
Condensed 900-weight uppercase display type; tabular numerals for money.
Die-cut clipped corners, punched hole, string; woven labels, stamped cells, barcodes and stitch rules as dividers.
Flat colour only: no gradients, no hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The Role-Not-Hex Rule
rules.body: Components consume field, paper, ink, sticker and their on- partners. A hard-coded hex in a component breaks every palette except the default.

rules.name: The One Sticker Rule
rules.body: The sticker colour marks the primary action or a price flag, one or two per view. Its rarity is what makes it read as a price-gun label.

rules.name: The Pair Rule
rules.body: Any new field or sticker colour ships with its readable partner (on-field, on-sticker) chosen by luminance; custom fields get this automatically via readableOn.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Prices and counts use the .num utility (tabular numerals) so digits align in tags and carts.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Display for names and prices, Archivo for sentences, Azeret Mono for stamped metadata. Do not set sentences in display or mono.

rules.name: The Wrapper Rule
rules.body: A tag is always Tag (wrapper plus clipped surface). Never apply box-shadow to a clipped element.

rules.name: The No-Block-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The system has no offset block shadows and no gradients. Hover feedback is a colour swap or a 2px lift, not a shadow.

dos: Do build every new surface as a Tag on the field: paper, ink text, clipped corners, wrapper drop shadow.
Do make the one primary action per view a Sticker button.
Do reference colour roles (bg-field, text-on-field, bg-paper, text-ink, bg-sticker) so all palettes and Custom work.
Do keep secondary text on paper at muted (6.9:1) and use on-field for anything directly on the field.
Do show sold-out and empty states as ghost cells that stay drawn.
Do respect data-motion="reduced" and prefers-reduced-motion for any new animation.
donts: Don't use gradients or offset block shadows.
Don't hard-code hex values in components; the palette changes at runtime.
Don't set body text on the field in ink or muted; light-field and dark-field palettes need on-field.
Don't make photo cards the container for interface; imagery sits inside a tag, never replaces it.
Don't set sentences in the display or mono face.
Don't put a box-shadow on a clipped tag; shadow the wrapper with drop-shadow.
